sources.what: Derived: ranks, density, distances, hemispheres, extremes, antipodes, closest countries (computed from data/countries.json and data/world.json)
sources.name: Computed by tools/encyclopedia/fetch.mjs

method.ranks: Competition ranking (1, 2, 2, 4), largest first, among the 195 states with a value (region ranks among that region); years can differ between states. World Bank values older than 2018 are stored (stats.*.ranked false, staleCore) but not ranked or compared. Ranked: population, area, gdp, gdpPerCapita, density, lifeExpectancy, the five other World Bank indicators and neighbourCount (sovereign neighbours among the 195 only).
method.density: countries.json population divided by world-countries total area (km²).
method.closest: Smallest absolute log ratio among the other 195 states (relative closeness).
method.distances: Great-circle between capital points, mean Earth radius 6,371 km, rounded to 1 km.
method.hemispheres: main: from the main-landmass bbox; all: from every polygon world.json draws for the state.
method.extremes: Main-landmass bbox from countries.json; north-south span is the meridian arc between the extreme latitudes.
method.antipode: Point-in-polygon of the capital antipode against world.json (spherical); otherwise the smallest Natural Earth marine polygon containing it; otherwise "open-ocean". nearestLand is the nearest world.json vertex, rounded to 10 km.
method.neighbours: inGeometry false: world-countries lists the land border but the 1:50m polygons share no boundary. viaOutlying*: every shared boundary lies on polygons outside that state's main-landmass bbox.
method.callingCodes: idd root + suffix when there is one suffix; root only for the shared +1 and +7 zones; otherwise root + each suffix as given.
method.corrections: ZWE ZAR currency symbol "Rs" -> "R" (the symbol the same dataset gives ZAR for ZAF, LSO, NAM, SWZ).
